dynamic_policy: Independent short normal-input cases; bounded player journeys only for lifecycle and terminal checks.
state_fixture_policy: No validated external semantic fixture adapter is bound; use bounded normal input, never hidden candidate hooks.
candidate_failure_policy: Affected checkpoints fail or unreachable with numeric zero; confirmed infrastructure failure prevents score publication.
coverage_policy: Fixed 36 owners and weights. Boundary evidence is mandatory; acquisition/setup gaps prevent aggregate publication unless the explicitly authorized DRAW source review resolves its missing witness. Missing evidence is never a passing default or candidate zero.
source_review_policy: Diagnostic source review, revision nightsky-source-review-3.1.1, for exactly simultaneous_draw (D3-09) and missed_bolt_cleanup (D3-04). Trusted manual call-flow review, GDD/project identity, source snapshots and citations are required. Runtime failures cannot be repaired by source passes. See contracts/source-review.md.
